Public Engineering Log • Signed Universal x64 & Native ARM64

Version History & Release Notes

Follow every milestone of RaggieSoft Installer Studio as it evolves in public as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software.

Download Latest v0.8.0 (Auto-Detects CPU) Full Offline v0.8.0 (x64 + ARM64 in One EXE) Suite Download Center & MSI Previous Versions (v0.5.0–v0.7.0)
Latest Release • November 27, 2026

v0.8.0 — Complete Servicing & Update System ([Upgrade], --plan-update, RsPatch.exe msdelta.dll & DRY RsUpdate.exe)

  • Declarative [Upgrade] Servicing & Zero-1638 Minor Upgrades: Full support for Windows Installer Major Upgrades (Schedule = early | late at sequence 1525 vs. 6550, MigrateFeatures Attributes = 257), Minor Upgrades (BaselineMsi ProductCode inheritance + automatic REINSTALL=ALL REINSTALLMODE=vomus detection in SetupWizard.exe), Small Update Hotfixes (--allow-small-update), and RaggieScript EXE (Engine = raggiescript) retired-file pruning with .rswbak rollback.
  • instbuild.exe --plan-update & RsPatch.exe (msdelta.dll Binary Deltas): Automated Microsoft Component-Rule verifier (RSW080–RSW086) plus native CreateDeltaB / ApplyDeltaB binary-delta compiler & transactional applier for both .MSP patches and RaggieScript EXE .rswpatch (RSWPATCH1) deltas.
  • RsUpdate.exe — 100% DRY Static-CDN Updater Shared with RaggieSoft Launcher: Zero-service white-label Win32 C++20 updater consuming the exact same apps-manifest.json JSON array schema as RaggieSoft Launcher (with instbuild.exe --emit-update-manifest, delta-first auto-selection, SHA-256 verification, --check exit code 10, and opt-in user scheduled tasks; 82/82 self-tests passing).
Milestone • November 27, 2026

v0.7.0 — Shared Cross-Studio Visual Canvas SDK, Dual Dialog Designers, Turnkey RsDialog & [Environment]/[IniFile]

  • Shared Cross-Studio 2D Visual Canvas SDK (RaggieSoftVisualCanvas.hpp): Zero-dependency Win32 C++20 authoring engine shared across Installer Studio, Showcase Studio, Launcher Studio, and Document Studio—featuring bi-directional logical-to-screen viewports, 8-grip selection handles, sibling/center smart alignment guides, WCAG 2.2 AA Arrow / Shift+Arrow keyboard nudging, #Tab + Alt+Key badges, and one-click -> .rssc export.
  • Dual Interactive WYSIWYG Dialog Designers + Turnkey RsDialog Suite: Interactive drag/resize authoring for both SetupWizard.exe ([Dialog.*] / [Control.*]) and 370×270 DLU MSI.DLL SQL forms ([MsiDialog.*] / [MsiControl.*]), paired with 12 turnkey RsWelcome..RsFinishReboot functions, automatic DialogResult.Back step rewinding, RSWBC2 SHA-256 bytecode, and raggiescript.exe fmt [--check] (Ctrl+Shift+F).
  • Declarative Non-Clobbering [Environment.*] PATH & [IniFile.*]: Safe segment-only PATH append/prepend and uninstall cleanup across both Engine = msi and RaggieScript EXE (Engine = raggiescript), plus RSW066–RSW069 validator gates (78/78 self-tests passing).
Milestone • November 2026

v0.6.0 — 4-Edition Engine, RaggieScript (.rssc), Read/Write MSI Prism, rswsfx.exe & Monotonic Dual-Bar Suites

  • Official Four-Edition Governance (Community == 100% Architect) & Standalone Tools: Shipped live Community, Essentials, Developer, and Architect tier rules, standalone 64-bit read/write RaggieSoft MSI Prism (msiprism.exe), and standalone RaggieSoft Self-Extractor (rswsfx.exe with _ISDEL.EXE-aware %TEMP% cleanup).
  • RaggieScript (.rssc), Deferred UAC, Disk Spanning, Loose Media & Suites: Added Uac.Deferred un-elevated wizard -> elevated commit handoff, multi-volume CAB1..N.cab spanning, msiexec /a loose media, .rswpak on-demand feature packs, True Dark AeroWizards, and byte-weighted monotonic Dual-Bar .rsis Suites.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.5.1 — Selectable PE UAC Execution Levels, $(VERSION) Tokens & Active MSI Queue Discovery

  • Added [Package] RequestedExecutionLevel (asInvoker, highestAvailable, requireAdministrator), CheckTokenMembership UAC-disabled verification, UpgradeCode single-instance mutexes, _MSIExecute queue waiting, and automatic $(VERSION) manifest expansion.
Signed Public Baseline • November 25, 2026

v0.5.0 — 10 Selectable Wizard Styles, Classic & Custom Setup Types, Billboards & WCAG Auto-Contrast

  • 10 Selectable First-Party Wizard Styles ([UI] WizardLayout): Shipped standard, wizard95 (#C0C0C0 3D beveled sheet + 164px sunken left graphic rail across every page), wizard97, aerowizard, fluentmica, oneclick, passivetoast, fullscreenblue, fullscreenteal (1995 #008080 ACME callback), and autorun16x9—all yielding automatically to SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST.
  • Classic Windows 95 & Author-Defined Setup Types + [Billboard.*]: Added 4-card win95_classic Setup Types (Typical, Compact, Complete, Custom), repeatable [SetupType.<Id>] cards, floating 3D [Billboard.<Id>] showcase cards, and expanded MSI.DLL ActionData file/byte progress formatting.
  • Live WCAG 2.2 AA Brand Contrast Enforcer (RswWcagContrast.hpp & RSW055): Added W3C relative luminance validation in instbuild.exe --validate plus a one-click Auto-Fix WCAG button in InstallerStudio.exe.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.5 — Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing, ARM64 /dlib Dispatch & Pre-Signed Template Safety

  • 100% Cryptographically Signed Release via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing: Dual-Layer Public Trust Authenticode signing with RFC 3161 SHA-256 timestamps across all inner C++20 executables, x64/ARM64 .msi databases, and Universal outer Setup.exe launchers.
  • Architecture-Aware /dlib SignTool Dispatch & Local Temp Resource Stamping: Automatic PE Machine matching for Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll on Windows 11 ARM64 plus clean ImageRemoveCertificate stripping.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.4 — Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers & Public FAQ

  • Replaced raw numeric InstallLevel inputs with human-friendly Included In tiers (minimal, typical, complete, hidden) and launched the public FAQ.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.3 — CPU-Aware Smart Web Stub & Combined Offline Universal Single-EXE (x64 + ARM64)

  • Added IsWow64Process2 Prism-piercing Smart Web Stubs and Combined Offline Universal EXEs with build-stamped SHA-256 verification.
Milestones • November 2026

v0.4.0 – v0.4.2 — 12-View Tree-First IDE, Dark-Mode Push Buttons & Native C++20 Help

  • Shipped 32-bit ARGB vector SysTreeView32 hierarchies, dedicated Features & RegEdit Registry trees, sub-16ms live Dark ↔ Light palette hot-swapping, and zero-dependency RaggieSoftHelp.exe.
Initial Milestones • November 2026

v0.1.0 – v0.3.0 — Static /MT C++20 Foundation, Component Rules, LZMS, Pre-MSI Runtimes & .MSM

  • Established the static /MT C++20 compiler, deterministic UUIDv5 GUIDs, ICE18/38/64/80 validation, Windows LZMS compression, Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] broker, 64-bit .MSM merger, and SelectionTree.
